notes: One response body per case, read by both clients' suites: shared/fixtures/__tests__/contract-fixtures.test.ts parses it with the Zod schema, and android/app/src/test/kotlin/com/royaraqamia/app/contracts/ContractFixturesTest.kt decodes it with the generated Kotlin type. A case is a line here and a file beside this one: deleting the file fails both suites because both read this manifest, and deleting the line fails both because both refuse a file the manifest does not list. Expectation is part of the fixture because the two clients must agree on which bodies are readable, not just on the readable ones.
